name: Streamer & Creator
hint: Balanced gaming plus streaming needs: Game Bar capture and background apps stay on for OBS and Discord, game QoS marking.
description: Built on Balanced for a PC that games and streams at the same time. Game Bar capture stays available, background apps keep running for OBS, Discord and stream tools, USB power saving is off for capture cards and webcams, and game traffic gets DSCP marking for routers that honor it. Interrupt moderation stays on because encoding needs the CPU time. The security baseline is the same as Balanced.
guidance: Use the GPU encoder in OBS (NVENC, AMF or Quick Sync) so encoding does not take CPU time from the game.
Run the Network Test and keep your stream bitrate well below the measured upload, so the game keeps headroom.
DSCP marking only helps when your router or switch honors it; check its QoS settings.
